column1: # OWASP ZAP rule tuning for the API scan (.github/workflows/zap-scan.yml).
# Every rule WARNs by default, and the run never fails on findings: they go to the "OWASP ZAP API
# scan" issue and the /security/ report. IGNORE a rule only with a reason; FAIL one that must never
# come back once it is fixed.
# Rule IDs come from the ZAP scan output (numeric, e.g. 10021, 100000).

column3: Non-Storable Content: informational, API responses are per-user and must not be cached
Unexpected Content-Type: only fires on the Swagger UI HTML pages; the API itself returns JSON
Persistent XSS in JSON: the API stores text as sent and returns it as application/json with nosniff; React escapes on render and the enforced CSP blocks inline scripts without the nonce
User Agent Fuzzer: informational; the responses differ because the scan changes the data between requests, not because of the User-Agent
